name: WPR Custom Cloud Simple
summary: This EA uses Williams' Percent Range (WPR) indicator with custom cloud visualization to identify overbought and oversold market conditions. It generates buy signals when WPR exits oversold territory and sell signals when WPR exits overbought territory, applying a mean reversion strategy. The 'Simple' variant likely uses straightforward threshold-based entries without complex filtering.
summary_zh: 该EA使用威廉指标(WPR)配合自定义云图可视化来识别市场超买超卖状态。当WPR从超卖区域回升时产生买入信号，从超买区域回落时产生卖出信号，采用均值回归策略。'Simple'版本可能使用简单的阈值入场，不带复杂过滤条件。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于威廉百分比范围(WPR)指标的均值回归逻辑。WPR指标衡量当前价格相对于近期价格区间的位置，数值在-100到0之间波动。当WPR跌破超卖阈值（通常-80以下）后回升穿越该阈值时，EA判断市场过度抛售后开始回归均值，触发买入信号。反之，当WPR升破超买阈值（通常-20以上）后回落穿越该阈值时，EA触发卖出信号。仓位管理方面，Simple版本可能使用固定手数或基于资金的简单计算方式。出场条件可能包含固定止盈止损或等待反向信号平仓。资金管理方面，该EA作为均值回归策略，在趋势行情中可能面临连续亏损的风险，需要合理的仓位控制和止损设置。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the mean reversion logic of the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) indicator. The WPR indicator measures where the current price sits relative to the recent price range, oscillating between -100 and 0. When WPR drops below the oversold threshold (typically below -80) and then crosses back above it, the EA identifies that the market has been oversold and is beginning to revert to the mean, triggering a buy signal. Conversely, when WPR rises above the overbought threshold (typically above -20) and then crosses back below it, the EA triggers a sell signal. For position sizing, the Simple variant likely uses fixed lot sizes or a straightforward account-balance-based calculation. Exit conditions may include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or waiting for a reverse signal to close positions. In terms of money management, as a mean reversion strategy, this EA faces the risk of consecutive losses during trending markets, requiring proper position control and stop-loss settings.

parameters.name: Overbought_Level
parameters.description: 超买阈值，WPR高于此值视为超买
parameters.description_en: Overbought threshold; WPR above this is overbought

parameters.name: Oversold_Level
parameters.description: 超卖阈值，WPR低于此值视为超卖
parameters.description_en: Oversold threshold; WPR below this is oversold

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

pros: WPR指标逻辑清晰，超买超卖信号易于理解和验证
均值回归策略在震荡行情中表现良好，盈亏比合理
Simple版本参数精简，降低了过拟合风险，便于用户理解和调优
云图可视化增强了指标的可读性，帮助交易者直观判断市场状态
pros_en: WPR indicator logic is clear, with overbought/oversold signals that are easy to understand and verify
Mean reversion strategy performs well in ranging markets with reasonable risk-reward ratios
The Simple variant has minimal parameters, reducing overfitting risk and making it easy for users to understand and tune
Cloud visualization enhances indicator readability, helping traders intuitively judge market conditions
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势行情中容易连续亏损，缺乏趋势过滤机制
Simple版本可能缺少新K线检查，容易在同一信号区域重复开仓
缺少点差过滤，在大幅点差时仍会入场，增加交易成本
如果止损设为0，则完全没有风控保护，可能导致大幅亏损
cons_en: Mean reversion strategies are prone to consecutive losses in strong trending markets due to the lack of trend filtering
The Simple variant may lack a new bar check, potentially opening repeated positions within the same signal zone
Lack of spread filter means entries can occur during wide spreads, increasing trading costs
If stop-loss is set to 0, there is no risk protection at all, which could lead to significant losses
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标（如均线方向），避免在强趋势中逆势交易
添加新K线检查和点差过滤，防止重复开仓和不利点差下入场
增加仓位管理选项，如基于ATR的动态止损止盈或固定风险比例计算手数
improvements_en: Add a trend filter indicator (e.g., moving average direction) to avoid trading against strong trends
Implement a new bar check and spread filter to prevent duplicate entries and entries during unfavorable spreads
Add position sizing options such as ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit or fixed fractional risk-based lot calculation

risk_points: 均值回归策略在趋势行情中可能持续逆势加仓导致严重亏损
如果止损参数为0则完全无风控保护
缺少新K线检查可能导致短时间内重复开仓
risk_points_en: Mean reversion strategy may continuously trade against the trend in trending markets, leading to severe losses
If stop-loss parameter is 0, there is no risk protection whatsoever
Lack of new bar check may result in repeated position openings within a short timeframe
